topics.title: My Free Time Activities
topics.description: Talk about your hobbies and free time activities.
topics.prompt: What do you usually do in your free time? Which activity do you enjoy most? Do you prefer doing activities alone or with friends? Why?
topics.sample_answer: In my free time, I enjoy reading books and playing badminton. Reading helps me relax and learn new things. I usually play badminton with my friends at the weekend. I prefer doing activities with other people because it is more fun. These activities make my free time more enjoyable.

topics.title: A Healthy Lifestyle
topics.description: Talk about how to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
topics.prompt: What do you do to stay healthy? What food should you eat? How much exercise should you do? Why is a healthy lifestyle important?
topics.sample_answer: To have a healthy lifestyle, I eat fresh vegetables and fruit every day. I also drink enough water and exercise regularly. I usually play sports with my friends after school. I try to get enough sleep and avoid eating too much junk food. A healthy lifestyle helps me feel energetic and study better.

topics.title: Helping My Community
topics.description: Talk about how you can make your community a better place.
topics.prompt: What problems can you see in your community? What volunteer activities can students do? Have you ever helped other people? How did you feel?
topics.sample_answer: I think students can do many things to help their community. They can clean the streets, plant trees and donate books or clothes to people in need. Last month, I joined a clean-up activity with my classmates. We collected rubbish around our school. I felt proud and happy because we made our neighbourhood cleaner.
